Quantum 1.26.1 was certified on 2026-09-04. It pins **nucleus v1.23.1**, **quark v1.10.1** and **orbit v1.8.20**, with 22 sibling modules.

A patch release of the suite after Quantum 1.26.0: nucleus goes from v1.23.0 to v1.23.1 (patch), quark goes from v1.10.0 to v1.10.1 (patch) and orbit goes from v1.8.17 to v1.8.20 (patch). 22 sibling modules change version.
